subject: an MCP server run record

msp-c-1.requires: The record lists every served tool whose definition digest differs from its approved pin, and every served tool that has no pin.
msp-c-1.why: a tool-description change after approval is the rug pull, and a record that omits it reads as a clean run

msp-c-2.requires: The record's version diff lists exactly the tools changed, added and removed against the previous version's digests.
msp-c-2.why: a reviewer approving an update reads the diff, so an omitted tool is a change nobody was shown

msp-c-3.requires: Every host the server contacted that its declared egress does not name is listed as undeclared.
msp-c-3.why: the egress record is the only part of the run that shows where data left, and an unlisted host is the one that mattered

msp-c-4.requires: A run whose egress was not recorded ends as couldnt-run, never as clean or flagged.
msp-c-4.why: a missing observation read as an empty one is how a server that crashed on start gets a clean badge

msp-c-5.requires: A clean outcome requires no pin mismatch and no undeclared host once both are recomputed from the observed fields.
msp-c-5.why: the outcome is the field a registry ingests, so it must follow from the observations beside it

msp-c-6.requires: The record binds the artifact it ran by a sha256 digest, not by a version string.
msp-c-6.why: a version string is a name its owner can re-point, so a record naming one describes whatever the name resolves to later

msp-c-7.requires: A run set's results add up to the servers attempted, and its headline denominator is the servers attempted.
msp-c-7.why: a server that crashed is still a server the registry asked about, and a headline over the survivors turns a failure rate into a pass rate

note: Every member is synthetic. A reject member violates one declared condition and differs from an accepting twin in one field, so a checker that refuses everything scores zero rather than full marks.

vectors.cites: no mismatch and no undeclared host, so clean follows

the same contact, absent from the undeclared list

the artifact is named by a version string

the server contacted a host its declaration does not name and the record lists it
the update changed one tool and the diff lists it; the pins were refreshed so the run is clean
